capabilities.justification: The `print` builtin inherited from lispy-runtime writes program output to stdout.
The twig-vm CLI and run_file/run_module_tree read the Twig source file the user names, and the files it imports, through bounded-source-file (regular files only, within the 1 MiB source budget).
`twig-vm --debug-port N` binds a loopback TCP listener and accepts one DAP adapter connection.

justification: A Twig interpreter and its CLI: it writes program output, reads the source files it is asked to run, and in debug mode listens on loopback for one debugger.
